title: Music of Australia - Wikipedia
text: Music of Australia The music of Australia has an extensive history made of music societies. Indigenous Australian music forms a significant part of the unique heritage of a 40,000- to 60,000-year history which produced the iconic didgeridoo.

title: Emily Wurramara - Wikipedia
text: Emily Wurramara is an Indigenous Australian / Filipino singer and songwriter. At the 2024 ARIA Music Awards, she won the ARIA Award for Best Adult Contemporary Album, making her the first Indigenous woman to ever win in this category.
